name: Sarkar Infinite
summary:
Sarkar Infinite is an official 3D action "beat 'em up" game that brings the raw power and intensity of cinematic Indian action cinema to your fingertips. Step into the role of a fearless hero standing against corruption and injustice, engaging in high-octane combat against relentless waves of enemies in beautifully rendered 3D environments.

Inspired by the blockbuster film culture of South Indian cinema, Sarkar Infinite delivers a 'Mass' movie experience where every punch, kick, and special move feels like a scene straight from the silver screen. Fight through urban landscapes, construction sites, and lavish interiors as you take on waves of thugs.
